plain_description.what: Judges about 1,980 matches twice with the reasoning version of grok: once with a rubric written for each cell of the tree and once with the generic rubric, then compares accuracy on questions with a known answer.
plain_description.why: Checks whether cell-specific rubrics help a stronger reasoning judge, after they gave little to a weaker judge.
plain_description.information: A gain would justify per-cell rubrics; none closes that line. Result: done; exactly zero gain (84.2% vs 84.2%). Together with other tests, cell rubrics are worth 0 to +1 point on keyed questions; the rubric line was closed. On the older p2dca question family, later ruled 'history, not evidence'.
